online.title: 🤖 From PoC to Production: ¡Lleva tus agentes de IA a producción con Responsible AI! 🚀
online.chapter: GDG on Campus UOC - Barcelona, Spain
online.registration: Free registration with Bevy Virtual Conference
online.blurb: Join Jesús Cuesta for a free online workshop on taking generative AI from proof of concept to production. Ideal for students, developers, and AI enthusiasts, learn to design and manage intelligent AI agents. Organized by GDG on Campus UOC on November 19. Register now!

online.title: Gathering at Deutsche Bank Berlin Technology Centre
online.where: Otto-Suhr-Allee 16, Berlin, State of Berlin, DE
online.blurb: Join us at Deutsche Bank Berlin Technology Centre for an engaging evening. Doors open at 18:00. The venue is conveniently located next to Ernst-Reuter-Platz station. Remember to bring a matching photo ID for security, and review the Code of Conduct. Stay tuned for an exciting speaker lineup announcement!

online.title: DevFest Maringá 2026
online.blurb: O DevFest Maringá é o maior evento de tecnologia da comunidade GDG Maringá, com palestras e workshops sobre web, mobile, cloud e IA. Data e local a confirmar em breve.

online.title: Started with a prompt
online.blurb: Join this collaborative event to explore Google Skills, designed for anyone looking to enhance their prompting and skill creation abilities. Ideal for beginners ready to take their first steps into improving their digital expertise.

online.title: Tech Escape Room Challenge
online.chapter: GDG on Campus Truman State University - Kirksville, United States
online.blurb: Experience the Escape Room Challenge: Collaboration Unleashed at Truman State University! Engage in a dynamic, team-based adventure to enhance problem-solving and communication. Perfect for both seasoned escapists and newcomers, this event promises a thrilling atmosphere and unique experience. Gather your friends and test your skills in this exciting escape quest.

online.title: Incident Investigation with Agentic Graphs: Cutting Triage from 45 to 5 Minutes
online.blurb: This case study walkthrough shows how an SRE team used a multi-agent AI framework to automate the full incident lifecycle (detection, triage, communication, mitigation, and RCA), cutting MTTR from about 45 minutes to under 5. We'll cover the architecture, how agents collaborate, share memory, and manage context, and how remediation runs safely in production with human-in-the-loop oversight.

online.title: GDG Columbus: Shots On Goal
online.blurb: Connect with Pete and Jim Friday morning to discuss your current projects! Show off your successes! Discuss future plans!

online.title: Build Night: From Code to Cloud — Building, Testing & Deploying Applications
online.chapter: GDG on Campus KCA University - Nairobi, Kenya
online.blurb: Join GDG for an interactive session on transforming ideas into deployable applications. Learn about designing, developing, and deploying functional apps with Firebase and cloud technologies. Gain practical experience, collaborate with fellow developers, and take your projects beyond local development. Ideal for developers ready to move from coding to product shipping. Bring your laptop and ideas.

online.title: Getting Started with GCP Cloud SQL: A Hands-On Workshop
online.blurb: GDG State College invites beginners to a hands-on workshop on Google Cloud SQL. Participants will learn to set up and manage databases on Google Cloud, and connect applications like Google Compute Engine and Google Cloud Run. Attendees should bring their laptops and get ready to explore cloud databases.

online.registration: Free registration with Bevy Virtual Conference
online.blurb: Join an exciting hands-on workshop to build multi-agent systems with the Agent Development Kit. Learn to manage parent-child relationships and maintain conversation state across sessions. Ideal for anyone looking to enhance their skills and network with like-minded enthusiasts. Secure your spot today!
